title: Marketing Operations Associate / Intern
subtitle: As a Marketing Operations Associate/Intern at our company, you will collab with Line Manager driving the success of our skincare and supplement brands across multiple platforms: DTC website, TikTok Shop, and Amazon.
body:
As a Marketing Operations Associate/Intern at our company, you will collab with Line Manager driving the success of our skincare and supplement brands across multiple platforms: DTC website, TikTok Shop, and Amazon. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing our marketing efforts to ensure the efficient execution of our campaigns and the achievement of our business goals.

## **Essential Roles and Responsibilities**

- **Proven Copywriting, Funnels, and Web Design Skills**: Expertise in crafting compelling copy, designing high-converting funnels, and creating visually appealing web designs that drive engagement and conversions.

- **Code, Canva, and Video Editing is a Plus**: Ability to code and edit videos, along with proficiency in Canva, to enhance marketing materials and campaigns.

- **Communication and Collaboration**: Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management skills, with a knack for clear and persuasive presentation of marketing strategies and results.

- **Adaptability and Learning**: Demonstrated ability to learn swiftly, stay up-to-date with industry trends, and adapt to new marketing platforms and technologies.

- **Team Alignment**: The ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to ensure that marketing operations are in alignment with the broader business objectives.

## **Skills and Qualifications**

- Fluent in English communication (Written and Spoken), with an IELTS score above 7.0 or equivalent.

- Strong leadership skills. Candidates need to provide proof of record of how they can increase their own team performance.

- Proactive learning behaviour. We request all people to learn daily (only learn things that can support your work immediately) and share it with others.

- A positive, “can do” attitude.

- Understand our core values: 100%, Winning Mentality, Teamwork. You can check it out here: patigroup.com. If you think this is something you have, give us proof.

## **Come join PATI, you will have a chance to enjoy**

- 4.000.000 VND per month (for intern level) or 7.000.000 VND to 10.000.000 VND (for Associate level) + incentive based on performance (negotiate)

- Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic Global Ecommerce environment

- To fully enjoy other social welfare regimes such as: social insurance, statutory leave,...

- Joining various team bonding activities.

We are looking for someone who shares our passion for wellness, our commitment to excellence, and our dedication to making a positive impact on our customers' lives. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you.

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh city

**🚀 APPLY [HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**
